name: SEG
recent: SEG International 在 2026 年 8 月宣布每股 1.5 仙的中期股息，除息日为 9 月 2 日，派发日为 9 月 18 日。公司于 8 月 20 日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度业绩，营收同比上升 18.5%，净利同比大幅增长。此外，公司于 8 月及 10 月多次公告提供财务援助。
notable: 宣布每股 1.5 仙的中期单层股息，除息日为 2026 年 9 月 2 日，派发日为 2026 年 9 月 18 日。
公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收同比增长 18.5%，净利同比增长 1302.4%。
于 2026 年 8 月及 10 月公告提供财务援助。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 58.099 million，同比上升 18.5%，环比下降 0.6%；净利为 MYR 3.464 million，同比上升 1302.4%，环比上升 15.2%；净利率为 6.0%，高于上一季度的 5.1%。

recent_en: SEG International declared an interim dividend of 1.5 sen per share in August 2026, with ex-date on 2 September and payment on 18 September. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 20 August, with revenue up 18.5% year-on-year and net profit rising sharply. It also announced the provision of financial assistance in August and October.
notable_en: Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 1.5 sen per share, with ex-date on 2 September 2026 and payment date on 18 September 2026.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 18.5% year-on-year and net profit up 1302.4% year-on-year.
Announced the provision of financial assistance in August and October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 58.099 million, up 18.5% year-on-year and down 0.6% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 3.464 million, up 1302.4% year-on-year and up 15.2% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 6.0%, compared with 5.1% in the previous quarter.
